name: DMD 4640
title: Digital Public History Project
description: (Also offered as HIST 4640.) Students work collaboratively, with instructor guidance and feedback, to design and complete a digital public history project or prototype.
requirement_description: HIST 3102; DMD 3610/HIST 3103; DMD 3620/HIST 3104; three credits of HIST 3890 or 3991; open to DMD majors or Digital Public History minors only, others with instructor consent.
